notes.title: ENDLESS MODE ULIMATE GUIDE
notes.notes:
Hi guys!

We are here to introduce you how Endless mode works. Are you ready? Let's take a look.

"Endless mode" is extremely fun and addictive. After you finished one enermy, you have a chance to choose 1 skill from the random 3 skills of choices to upgrade your character. The skills are devided into 3 types: Ultimate Attack, Buff and Perk.

Ultimate Attack can be equiped on your both hands, so it is limited up to 2 slots. If you choose the same skill it will level up. On the other hands, It will replace your former skill if you choose it differently. 

Unlike the Ultimate, Buff and Perk can be stacked and can be collected as much as you want. Buff will increase your status point while Perk will give you a special abilities.

For those are still confusing, we have an ultimate guide book for you, so you can choose wisely. 

[b]1. Ultimate Attack[/b]
